Access top GPT-series models with pay-as-you-go billing and no ID verification. The models are smart, with quota usage similar to the official DeepSeek service.
Register with AIHub, top up your balance, and create a token in the console to get an API key. The URL, key, and model ID all come from AIHub.
1. Create an account
Register through the invite link below (copyable).
2. Top up your balance
Open Wallet management in the sidebar and top up as needed. Start with a small amount if you are trying it for the first time.
3. Create and copy an API token
Find Token management in the console sidebar.
Tap Show actions, then Add token.
Enter any name and select a group based on your budget. More expensive groups are generally more stable; choose the full-capability channel if your budget allows, then submit.
After creating the token, tap the copy button next to the key to copy and save your API key.

Before you start
The URL, key, and model ID all come from DeepSeek; the Base URL and key must match.
1. Get an API key
Open the key page → Create API key (any name) → copy and save it. You cannot view the full key again after closing the dialog.
Copy key page URL
Open website
Never share or publish your API key.
%1$d. Enter connection details
Back in settings, enter this Base URL under Connection:
Copy Base URL
Paste your key into API Key under Credentials; leave it blank later to keep the saved key.
%1$d. Add and select a model
Manage models → Fetch from provider → select a model → Done. If fetching fails, use Add custom model with the provider’s model ID.
%1$d. Test the connection
Tap Test model. A response means it works. If it fails, check the URL, key, model ID, balance, and network.
%1$d. Start editing
Click Edit mod on a mod card to use AI to edit the mod.
SiliconFlow includes a free quota. Register, complete ID verification, then create an API key. The URL, key, and model ID all come from SiliconFlow.
1. Register and verify
Register through the invite link below (copyable).
After registering, complete ID verification: Account → ID verification, then follow the prompts.
2. Create and copy an API key
API keys → New API key → type any description → Create key → tap the key and choose Copy.

AgentRouter is an OpenAI-compatible API gateway. Register, create a token in the console, and you have your API key. The URL, key, and model ID all come from AgentRouter.
1. Create an account
Register through the invite link below (copyable).
2. Create and copy an API token
Console → API tokens → Add token → type any name → Submit → copy the generated API key.
5. Switch to the Responses API
In settings, go to Request options → API protocol and select Responses before testing the connection.
